chronology.details: Exactly one coordinate system was created, named, transformed, checked for zero external references, and saved with zero errors and zero warnings. The original tool then failed its session-empty assertion after CloseDoc.
Attach-only recovery failed with TYPE_E_ELEMENTNOTFOUND before transform recovery.

Strong-typed recovery confirmed the single CoordSys, identity transform, zero external references, current-title CloseDoc, target hash, unchanged Stage A, empty document state, ExitApp invocation, and completion of WaitForExit.
After WaitForExit returned, the recovery tool attempted to read ExitCode from a Process object that had attached to, but had not started, SolidWorks.
chronology.error_message: 进程不是由此对象启动的，因此无法确定所请求的信息。

technical_adjudication.root_cause: The recovery tool treated Process.ExitCode as readable for an externally attached process. On this runtime, the Process object was not the launcher and raised InvalidOperationException even after WaitForExit completed.
why_full_pass_is_withheld: The immutable first-launch receipt is FAIL_CLOSED_FIRST_LAUNCH.
No normal recovery PASS receipt was produced.
The required cold-process reopen was not run and was not authorized.

corrective_action_for_future_authorized_.tool_change: Use process disappearance or HasExited as the normal-exit evidence for an externally attached SolidWorks process; record ExitCode as UNAVAILABLE when the runtime does not expose it, and never convert that unavailable metadata alone into a CAD diagnostic failure.
required_runtime_evidence: Cold open of the fixed target
Exactly one CS_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY of type CoordSys

claim_limit: INCIDENT CONSOLIDATION ONLY; NO FULL SINGLE-CS DIAGNOSTIC PASS, NATIVE AUTHORING RELEASE, H10, T005, CONTROL RELEASE, COMPLETE, MANUFACTURING, FLIGHT, OR LAUNCH QUALIFICATION CREDIT
